event: 2025 ILCA 6 Women's & ILCA 7 Men's World Championships
procedural_matters: ESP 223701 did not ask to withdraw the protest after the arbitration meeting and neither boat took a Post-Race Penalty under RRS T1(a).
ESP 223701 was represented by Marga Pirelli.
CAN 220149 was represented by Lilly Rainham.
Kyle Martin (Coach of CAN 220149) attended the hearing as an observer.
Charlotte Rose (USA 222035) gave evidence as a witness for CAN 220149.
ESP 223701 presented tracking as evidence during the hearing.
facts: At race 3, wind was 6 knots, sea state was choppy.
ESP 223701 and CAN 220149 were on the first beat approaching mark 1.
ESP 223701 was on starboard tack and above the layline. CAN 220149 was on port tack. Both boats were on a collision course.
6 boat lengths away from the mark, CAN 220149 tacked onto the starboard layline.
After CAN 220149 passed head to wind and before she was on a close-hauled course, ESP 223701 luffed and tacked to port.
The closest distance between the two boats was 0.5 m.
There was no contact between the two boats.
conclusions: After passing head to wind and before being on a close-hauled course, CAN 220149 failed to keep clear of ESP 223701. CAN 220149 broke RRS 13.
